units.source_text: 既是有意思，今夜我同你说的，全太有意思了。

en.t: If it is interesting, then everything I told you tonight was far too interesting.

units.source_text: 仔细想想，我说的全是几千年来，几千万人乃至几亿人的梦幻与愿望。

en.t: Thinking about it carefully, everything I spoke of was the dreams and wishes of tens of millions, even hundreds of millions, of people over thousands of years.

units.source_text: 难道我这个女子偏偏是作为人的一滴眼泪，作为象征的抒情诗，而在这世上生下来的？

en.t: Could it be that I, this woman, was born into this world precisely as a single tear of humanity, as a symbolic lyric poem?
